translations.web: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
translations.bsb: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
translations.kjv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
translations.asv: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he sent, him ye believe not.
